name: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE), Hyderabad

programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management - Agri-Business Management (PGDM-ABM)
programs.feeNote: Prospectus 2026-28 total for two years: tuition Rs 4,05,000 (2 x 2,02,500) + boarding & lodging Rs 4,94,000 (fully residential, twin sharing) + other heads (library, study material, computer & internet, student welfare etc.) Rs 76,000 = Rs 9,75,000. Provisional and subject to upward revision; hostel during summer project/vacation extra. 2027-29 prospectus not yet published as of 2026-11-12.
programs.intakeNote: AICTE Mandatory Disclosure: 120 seats (sanctioned 100 from 1996 to 2024, 120 since 2024); 100% of seats through CAT; no management quota.
programs.placementNote: Prospectus 2026-28: maximum CTC for batch 2023-25 Rs 21 LPA, average Rs 12.38 LPA; Mandatory Disclosure lists average package 12.38 LPA (previous two years 12.33 and 12.16 LPA). Median not used here (not in the documents fetched). Audit not stated.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on CAT score/percentile (category-wise)
selectionProcess.weightage: CAT 55 (candidate's CAT score / highest CAT score x 55)
selectionProcess.detail: CAT scorecard to be submitted by the stated date (10 Feb in the 2026 cycle). Eligibility: bachelor's in agriculture or allied disciplines with at least 50% (45% SC/ST/PwD).

selectionProcess.name: Essay writing, group discussion and personal interview at MANAGE Hyderabad
selectionProcess.weightage: Essay 5, GD 12, PI 17, work experience up to 5, academic record 6 (Class XII x2 + graduation x4)
selectionProcess.detail: Final merit list on the sum of all components (total 100); PI and essay held in April in the 2026 cycle.

selectionWeightage.note: From Prospectus 2026-28 (2026 admission cycle); 2027 policy not yet published.

keyDates.notes: Admission uses CAT 2026 (29 Nov 2026). 2027 admission notification not yet published as of 2026-11-12; in the 2026 cycle CAT scorecards were due 10 Feb 2026, PI/essay in April 2026 and results April/May 2026. Application fee Rs 600 (Rs 200 SC/ST).
